items.title: Content automation - 'Content created' trigger with approval node
items.description: A workflow canvas: 'Content created - Start a run when a new content asset is created' with Configuration/Documentation/History tabs and Project/Content type fields, beside an Approval node (Reviewer Razia, Due 12/11/2026, Approval/Changes requested/Rejected) under Run all / Activate. A content-ops automation builder.

items.title: recruitpilot - DACH Tech-CTOs sequence with German templates
items.description: A German CRM 'recruitpilot': Kampagnen ▸ DACH Tech-CTOs with Analytics/Leads/Sequenz/Einstellungen tabs, 'Vernetzungsanfrage – Schritt 1' editor ('Hi Vorname, ich bin Dein Name von adfects...') and 'LinkedIn-Nachricht – Schritt 2' with templates (Danke fürs Vernetzen). Sidebar: Dashboard/Piloten/Leads/Kampagnen/Nachrichten/Kunden. Same product as IMG-0484.

items.title: Hospital HR - 3,200 employees with satisfaction gauge
items.description: An 'Employee' admin: Total Employee 3,200 (Doctors and Specialists 800, Nurses 2000, Pharmacy 100), Employee Satisfaction 75-point gauge, Attendance Overview (On Time/On Late/On Leave) and an Employee List table (Dr. John Smith Cardiologist, Dr. Jane Doe Pediatrician...). A hospital workforce board, not a CRM.

items.title: wandor - 'Let's make this trip yours' with a sticker skyline
items.description: A travel landing for 'wandor': an illustrated pagoda, 'Let's make this trip yours', a prompt card ('I'm planning a 7-day trip to Japan in October...') with Plan my trip, and a sticker collage of world landmarks (Sagrada Familia, Opera House, Eiffel, Big Ben, Colosseum) above Explore/Company/Legal. A trip-planner hero.

items.title: Wave cycling - readiness 82 with FTP interval workout
items.description: A dark 'Wave' training app with pink accents: week strip (WED 21), '82 High - Readiness Thursday, Aug 27', 'Todays workout 4x8 min FTP Intervals' bar chart (1:23, 248w, TSS 90), Start workout, Training Load (Acute 112, Chronic 95) and Home/Plan/+/Club/Profile. A cycling home, not a light health chart.

items.title: Shapes to blur to final - 'Welcome to Nova AI' tutorial
items.description: A dark tutorial: three phones labelled 'Shapes → Blur effect → Final Design' - flat blue circles, their blur, then a 'Welcome to Nova AI - Publish projects while you are sleeping' splash with Get Started. A design-process explainer.

items.title: focus3 zen - 'The wind passes. The sky remains clear.'
items.description: A focus3 section: 'The wind passes. The sky remains clear.' with 'Only three intentions a day. Done, and close the screen.', a Daily Intentions card (morning run, vector drawings, forest walk & deep reading) and EXPORT A ZEN CARD over soft hills. The same product as IMG-0188.

items.title: Structurely - real-estate contacts with campaign responses
items.description: A 'Structurely' CRM: Contacts table (Thomas Anderson, Kevin O'Connor, Sarah Mitchell...) with response previews, channels, campaigns (FHA Refi Outreach, VA IRRRL Streamline, New Purchase Pre-A...), filter tabs (Responded, Qualified, Appointment Request) and an agent context menu (Assign agent, Mute, Message, Open, Close). An English real-estate CRM, not French.
